Anatomical RIGHT is FAR side; far right shoulder and upper arm behind qin, its forearm/wrist emerges naturally near LOWER RIGHT strings to pluck. No projectiles, no sparks, no baked magic, no shadow/ground, no background/checkerboard/text, no extra limbs or instrument, no mirror/duplicate/interpolation. ATTACK W02/12 EARLY ANTICIPATION. Preserve reference1's CORRECT near sleeve across the strings, left hand upper-left, far right hand lower-right. Lower hips subtly through knee flexion and transfer weight toward rear screen-right leg. Torso inclines a little back-right while gaze stays west. Both boots remain planted in their same positions. LEFT support elbow tightens and draws qin neck slightly toward chest/up, changing qin tilt only3degrees.
